I'll build a single self-contained page: a dark hero with one vegan ramen bowl, drawn inline so it stays responsive and reacts to the pointer without any external files.

events.content:
`index.html` is a single dark scene with one bowl of vegan ramen. Everything is inline, and the page does not load any external files.

The bowl sits in a warm pool of light. Wavy noodles rest in a glossy broth with shiitake, corn, tofu, nori, bok choy, scallion, wood ear, and chili oil. Steam rises on its own. Moving the pointer tilts the bowl, shifts the light, and leans the steam. Near the broth the glow strengthens, and a click on the surface sends a ripple and a thicker puff of steam.

If `prefers-reduced-motion` is on, the steam, broth, and tilt stay still. The bowl scales to the viewport on both desktop and phone, with no text or controls in the scene.
